A mother traveled three hours by ferry to ensure her 11-month-old daughter received the vaccine due to local shortages. Health experts emphasize the critical nature of early intervention, as the infection can lead to death within 24 hours of symptom onset. They recommend five preventive measures: avoiding close contact with infected individuals, enhancing immunity, seeking immediate medical attention if symptoms arise, ensuring comprehensive vaccination against five serogroups, and maintaining good personal hygiene and ventilation.
